name: relay-floor-12
description: A relay peer with a lower fee floor than its neighbours forwards 50 to 100 declined-at-the-strict-node payments per inter-block interval together with valid ones (four nodes, one jar, twelve bursts per block at about 20 s, sustained load): measured are the valid payments relayed through it that reach the strict node only after the next block (p_delayed_past_block), the same for an unrelated peer (q_delayed_past_block), and the declines per interval. Below the activity floor (fewer than 4 intervals with 50 declines at S, or fewer than 40 valid sends per payer) a run is INCONCLUSIVE. The expectations encode the hypothesis of ergoplatform/ergo#2641's thread: base never delays past a block; the candidate does in a majority of pairs.
